story.value: The name copper comes from the Latin cuprum, for Cyprus, the island where the Romans first obtained copper.
The symbol Cu also comes from the Latin cuprum.
Copper has been known since prehistoric times.

uses.value: The electrical industry uses copper in the form of wire.
Since it resists corrosion from the air, moisture and seawater, copper has been widely used in coins.
Copper is used to make water pipes and jewelry.
